native.scope: Complete matching-build native profile at fdca1796, before the separate pen-repeat-only follow-up.

limitations: Physical Android/iOS touch is unverified; desktop mobile emulation is recorded separately.

Real YouTube service playback and physical Windows Escape are unverified. Offline iframe fullscreen entry and player-button exit are tested in native main/popout; both browser artifacts additionally test a nested cross-origin provider fixture.
Sky could inventory the test window but failed twice to activate it; no physical input was sent, and the owned fixture was cleaned up.
Native macOS/Linux and an isolated whole-application cold restart are unverified.
The exact #3051 Lazy Loader / approximately 60-plugin startup interaction is not reproduced. Controlled late enablement and absent/incomplete Extras recovery are tested.
The inherited fork test:update command remains failed; no failed snapshot was accepted.
No package publication, dependency/version bump or personal-vault deployment is part of this PR.

finalFollowUp.scope: Only production difference from fdca1796 is the pen-repeat guard; two test files strengthen state-commit and actual repeated-key assertions.
